search_text: published ZDI-14-249 ZDI-CAN-2079 Advantech WebAccess Remote Authentication Bypass Vulnerability 2014-07-18 CVE-2014-2367 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2014-2367 7.5 ['Advantech'] ['Advantech WebAccess'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication requirements on vulnerable installations of Advantech WebAccess. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the ChkCookieNoRedir function. title: Advantech WebAccess Remote Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication requirements on vulnerable installations of Advantech WebAccess. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the ChkCookieNoRedir function. By providing arbitrary values to certain fields, an attacker can receive a session authentication cookie despite receiving an error message.
